# More, smaller pledges keep less of the same total raised.

> Free Kickstarter fee calculator. 5% platform fee plus per-pledge processing (3% + $0.20 standard, 5% + $0.05 under $10) -- see why more, smaller pledges keep less of the same total raised. Nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
